Question: Five resistances of 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30 ohms are connected in parallel. Calculate the joint resistance.

Options: 
A. 3.46 ohms
B. 4.56 ohms
C. 8.23 ohms
D. 4.12 ohms
E. 6.78 ohms
F. 7.89 ohms
G. 1.92 ohms
H. 2.34 ohms
I. 2.21 ohms

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
